comment: Read from src/Domain.cpp at commit 71e0bcb, the last commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.30. Four parameters are declared and never given a widget: TO2_BUTTON_PARAMS 0 to 3, which the maker's own comment at Domain.cpp:20 says are not used because one button is shared by both switches of a row. They have no position in the census and no click can reach them, so they get no line. The signal jacks carry whatever is patched into them, so they are given no family. The master control inverts each row's switch state rather than forcing it, and it is applied before the per-row latch (Domain.cpp:198), so pressing it while a row is latched toggles that row rather than holding it. The big master button and the per-row Switch and Latch buttons have no printed labels; only Gate, Latch, 2 -> 1 and 1 -> 2 are printed. This module has no appendContextMenu at all, so unlike nine of the fourteen it offers no panel-colour submenu; Canyon, Reflection, Seethe and Tonnet are the same.
